cohort: The study included 1271 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), divided into a group using traditional monitoring before September 2017 and a group using the myDiabby(r) app after September 2017.
finding: The use of the myDiabby(r) mobile glucose monitoring software was associated with significantly improved glycemic control and a lower risk of C-section in pregnant women with GDM.
mod_finding: The myDiabby(r) group experienced a significantly lower risk of C-section (11.3% vs. 17.2%, P=0.004), and telemedicine was independently associated with a lower rate of C-section.
